```artifact
Feature: Doorstop Unique and Permanent Identifiers and Support for Formatting

  Scenario Outline: Linkable sections should have unique and permanent identifiers
    Given a new Doorstop instance
    When a linkable section with text 'A linkable section with text' is added
    Then the linkable section should have a unique identifier
    And the identifier should be permanent
    Examples:
      | Description of Linkable Section |
      | A linkable section with text     |

  Scenario Outline: Formatting within linkable text should be supported
    Given a new Doorstop instance
    When a linkable section with text 'A linkable section with **bold** text' is added
    Then the text should be formatted as **bold**
    Examples:
      | Description of Linkable Section |
      | A linkable section with **bold** text |

  Scenario Outline: Support for external requirements assets
    Given a new Doorstop instance
    When an external requirements asset at '/path/to/asset1' is imported
    Then the asset should be stored in the system
    Examples:
      | Asset File Path |
      | /path/to/asset1 |

  Scenario Outline: Import content from other requirements management tools
    Given a new Doorstop instance
    When content from 'ToolA' is imported
    Then the content should be available for viewing and manipulation
    Examples:
      | Import Source |
      | ToolA         |

  Scenario Outline: Export content to common text/document tools
    Given a Doorstop instance with content
    When the content is exported to 'PDF' format
    Then the exported document should be compatible with common text/document tools
    Examples:
      | Export Format |
      | PDF           |

  Scenario Outline: View requirements as a document
    Given a Doorstop instance with content
    When the document is viewed
    Then the document should display the requirements in a structured format
    Examples:
      | View Type |
      | Document  |

  Scenario Outline: View document items interactively
    Given a Doorstop instance with content
    When a document item is selected for viewing
    Then the item should be displayed interactively
    Examples:
      | Document Item |
      | Item1         |

  Scenario Outline: Baseline versions of requirements
    Given a Doorstop instance with requirements
    When a requirement is selected for baseline versioning
    Then the baseline version should be saved
    Examples:
      | Requirement ID |
      | R001           |

  Scenario: Negative Test - Invalid linkable section text
    Given a new Doorstop instance
    When a linkable section with text 'Invalid text' is added
    Then the system should display an error message
    Examples:
      | Description of Linkable Section |
      | Invalid text                     |

  Scenario: Negative Test - Invalid formatting
    Given a new Doorstop instance
    When a linkable section with text 'A linkable section with **invalid_format** text' is added
    Then the system should display an error message
    Examples:
      | Description of Linkable Section |
      | A linkable section with **invalid_format** text |

  Scenario: Negative Test - Invalid asset path
    Given a new Doorstop instance
    When an external requirements asset at '/path/to/invalid_asset' is imported
    Then the system should display an error message
    Examples:
      | Asset File Path |
      | /path/to/invalid_asset |

  Scenario: Negative Test - Invalid import source
    Given a new Doorstop instance
    When content from 'InvalidTool' is imported
    Then the system should display an error message
    Examples:
      | Import Source |
      | InvalidTool   |

  Scenario: Negative Test - Invalid export format
    Given a Doorstop instance with content
    When the content is exported to 'InvalidFormat'
    Then the system should display an error message
    Examples:
      | Export Format |
      | InvalidFormat |

  Scenario: Negative Test - Invalid view type
    Given a Doorstop instance with content
    When the document is viewed with an invalid view type
    Then the system should display an error message
    Examples:
      | View Type |
      | InvalidType |
```
